mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sla_config WHERE biz_tag = #{bizTag} AND priority = #{priority} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sla_config (biz_tag, priority, response_minutes, resolution_minutes, escalation_minutes, emergency_threshold, calendar_id) VALUES (#{bizTag}, #{priority}, #{responseMinutes}, #{resolutionMinutes}, #{escalationMinutes}, #{emergencyThreshold}, #{calendarId})
mapper.update: UPDATE sla_config SET biz_tag=#{bizTag}, priority=#{priority}, response_minutes=#{responseMinutes}, resolution_minutes=#{resolutionMinutes}, escalation_minutes=#{escalationMinutes}, emergency_threshold=#{emergencyThreshold}, calendar_id=#{calendarId}, is_active=#{isActive} WHERE id=#{id}
